sources.claim: Strict callback tries daemon verification first; known_hosts only as fallback.
External default SSH port 22; internal SSH port 22022. These constants do not prove remote reachability.
Banner classification uses NetBird-SSH-Server and JWT marker.
Detect exits 2 for regular server AND detection failure; exit code alone cannot discriminate.
Daemon verifier requests GetPeerSSHHostKey; compares returned stored public key to presented key.
Stored key parse and exact public-key bytes comparison; callback tries hostname then remote address.
GetPeerSSHHostKey request field1 peerAddress; response key1/IP2/FQDN3/found4. No JWT/config RPC called.
ProtectedPrefix/Administrators pipe is tried before the plain name; no plain/TCP downgrade used here.
Official daemon pipe dial uses SECURITY_IDENTIFICATION; adapter matches this level.
